dataset.attribution: Bevan Koopman and Guido Zuccon, CSIRO, 2016. Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
dataset.comparison_normalization: Full-text corroboration compares both eligibility sections or the full eligibility block, in order, after case-folding, Unicode normalization, normalization of comparison operators, and removal of numbering, typographic punctuation and headings. Age comparisons use structured values. Source bytes and local selection hashes are independently provided.
dataset.hash_note: SHA-256 computed on bytes retrieved from the CSIRO data repository.
dataset.join_method: Match the complete frozen criterion as a contiguous lexical sequence, with the same inclusion/exclusion section where explicit. Original scientific operators and units preserved. If no section header is available, only unscoped literal matches may be recorded. Audited immutable original XML is the source for age/sex fields independently of text-revision comparison.
dataset.name: A Test Collection for Matching Patient to Clinical Trials
dataset.source_bridge_policy: A study-wide December 2015 bound is corroborated for this retrospective benchmark only when the official current bound agrees, the official record was last submitted by the NIH release date, and either a full normalized eligibility text matches from at least one source or the official registry record has the same last-update date as the historical source. Preserve divergent endpoints explicitly. Each case-level criterion join must independently preserve its wording and source polarity. This procedure does not establish absence of intervening amendments.

NCT01519271.version_hold_reason: The frozen NIH narrative does not align in full with either archived or current text under the documented comparison, and the registry changed after 2015.
